Color identity: WUBRG | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Time Sieve (battlefield); Academy Manufactor (battlefield); Tireless Tracker (battlefield); Izzet Boilerworks (hand); Mondrak, Glory Dominus (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
Steps: Play Izzet Boilerworks.
  When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
  Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
  Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
  Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Repeat each turn.

  Repeat from step 3 each turn.

Start: Yannik, Scavenging Sentinel (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Phantom Steed (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Mardu Siegebreaker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
  When Yannik enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
  When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Yannik until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
  When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Marina Vendrell (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Funeral Room // Awakening Hall (battlefield: with Awakening Hall locked); Thornbite Staff (battlefield: attached to Marina); Viscera Seer (battlefield)

## Combo 2232-2368-3475-4608-5220

Produces: Infinite blinking; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Tom Bombadil (hand); The World Spell (battlefield); Mortuary (battlefield); Cloudstone Curio (battlefield); Starfield of Nyx (battlefield)
Prerequisites: The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
  You control five or more enchantments.
Steps: At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.

  Cloudstone Curio and The World Spell's third chapter ability trigger.

  Resolve the World Spell trigger, causing you to put Tom Bombadil onto the battlefield from your hand and sacrifice The World Spell.
  Repeat from step 3.
  If desired, you may return a creature card to your hand in step 5, which can then be returned in step 2 for infinite blinking of any creature(s).
